note: Scheduled jobs and rules. Usually edited on the Jobs page (Schedules and Rules); this file can also be edited by hand, then press Reload. Each schedule runs a job kind (src-tauri/src/job_kinds.rs) with its input: command (script, folder), ai (provider: ollama, llama_cpp, claude_code, codex or grok_build; model; prompt; folder; endpoint) or notify (title, text, urgency: low, normal or critical; sound). A script can report a result by writing JSON to the file $JOB_RESULT: {"label": "disk_high", "value": {"percent": 92}, "message": "..."}, and progress (40/100) to $JOB_PROGRESS. when: manual (only Run now or a rule), once (at), every (interval: 30s, 10m, 2h, 14d), daily (time), weekly (day, time) or monthly (day 1 to 31, time). Times are local: HH:MM and YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. Optional: enabled (true), catch_up (true: a run missed while the app was closed runs once at start), max_runs, until, timeout_ms, retries (0 to 10), retry_wait (1m), retry_doubling (true), note. A rule: when a schedule ends (done, failed, timed_out, killed, not_done or any), optionally with a result label, a value test (value: field, above, below, equals), changed (true: the output or value differs from the last success), a number of times in a row, then start, enable or disable a schedule. A job started by a rule gets the earlier job's result: $PREVIOUS_OUTPUT, $PREVIOUS_VALUE and the rest in a script, {previous_output}, {previous_value.percent} and the rest in a prompt or notification. See docs/usage.md.

schedules.name: demo_disk_check
schedules.note: Every hour: how full / is, reported as the value {"percent": N}. The rule demo_disk_full reacts when it is over 90.

input.script:
pct=$(df --output=pcent / | tail -n 1 | tr -dc '0-9')
printf '{"value":{"percent":%s},"message":"The disk / is %s%% full."}' "$pct" "$pct" > "$JOB_RESULT"
df -h / | tail -n 1

schedules.name: demo_disk_advice
schedules.note: Started by the rule demo_disk_full: asks the local model what to do about it. Ollama must be running.

schedules.name: demo_tell_advice
schedules.note: Started by the rule demo_advice_ready: shows the model's answer as a desktop notification.

schedules.name: demo_watch_hosts
schedules.note: Every 10 minutes: reads /etc/hosts. The rule demo_hosts_changed reacts when it differs from the last time.

schedules.name: demo_morning_ai
schedules.note: Asks the local Ollama model for a line each morning at 08:00, made up once at start if the app was closed then. Ollama must be running.

input.prompt: Write one cheerful sentence to start the day.

schedules.name: demo_month_end
schedules.note: Runs on the last day of each month at 23:00, at most 12 times.

rules.name: demo_disk_full
rules.note: When the disk check reports over 90 percent twice in a row, ask the AI for advice. Set enabled to true to try it (with demo_advice_ready).

rules.name: demo_advice_ready
rules.note: When the AI has answered, show its answer as a notification.

rules.name: demo_hosts_changed
rules.note: When /etc/hosts differs from the last successful read, show a notification.
